verdict.rationale: Mailgun's webhooks API reference page states that real-time email event data is sent directly to your application without API polling. That is a first-party outbound HTTP callback mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single short summary line. It does not show how a subscription is registered (API or dashboard), which event types can be subscribed to, or how payloads are signed, retried or delivered. Related tracking and bounce features are adjacent, not webhook subscription. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription mechanics, an enumerated list of subscribable event types, payload signing and retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Get real-time email event data sent directly to your application. Automate responses and analytics without API polling.
